```text
NOTES ABOUT HEKO SKILL SCRIPTS:
- skill_points contains the current/goal skill points
- weight contains a default value (100) and affects the development of a skill (weight = 0 stops it, be careful with that)
- the chance to develop a skill is equal to the weight divided by the sum of all hero skill weights
- Every such script file should have the same params of "Default.vs"
- it is possible to use different scripts for different AI profiles in their respective folders

This is the list of all possible hero skill scripts:
- "Default.vs", which is run when there is no script file for the respective skill
- "Administration.vs"
- "Team attack.vs"
- "Team defense.vs"
- "Quick March.vs"
- "Epic endurance.vs"
```

## 16. DATA/AI HELPERS/SIEGE.VS

```text
<<<<<<< HD
// void, str GroupName, str Target

// Guard AI Helper

Settlement set;
int AIPlayer;
ObjList ol;
Obj oTarget;
Unit u, uEnemy;
Query qryDef;
int i, j, n, nEnemies;
point pt;
int nMaxCatapults = 1;
bool bSieging, bToSiege;
rect rcMap;

set = GetSettlement(Target);
if (!set.IsValid)
	return;

qryDef = Group(GroupName);
ol = qryDef.GetObjList();
if (ol.count <= 0)
	return;
AIPlayer = ol[0].player;
rcMap = GetMapRect;

/// Outpost
if (set.IsOutpost)
{
	oTarget = set.GetCentralBuilding;
	
	// Find gather point
	while (1)
	{
		ObjList olAdvance;
		int nReached = 0;
		ol = qryDef.GetObjList();
		if (ol.count <= 0)
			return;
		for (j = 0; j < ol.count; j += 1)
		{
			u = ol[j].AsUnit;
			if (u.hero.IsValid) continue;
			if (u.DistTo(oTarget) > oTarget.sight * 3 / 2)
			{
				if (u.command != "advance")
					olAdvance.Add(u);
			} else {
				if (u.command != "capture" && u.command != "attack")
					u.SetCommand("capture", oTarget);
				nReached += 1;
				if (u.AsHero.IsValid)
					nReached += u.AsHero.army.count();
			}
		}
		if (olAdvance.count > 0)
			olAdvance.ExecCmd("advance", oTarget.pos, u, false);
		if (nReached >= ol.count * 2 / 3)
			break;
		Sleep(2000);
	}
	// pr("Army's gathered");

	ol = qryDef.GetObjList();
	if (set.UnitsCount == 0)
		bToSiege = false;
	else {
		Query ProtectiveArea, EnemyUnits;
		ProtectiveArea = ObjsInSight(set.GetCentralBuilding, "Unit");
		EnemyUnits = Intersect(ProtectiveArea, EnemyObjs(AIPlayer, "Unit"));
		nEnemies = set.UnitsCount + EnemyUnits.count;
		bToSiege = ol.count < 2 * nEnemies;
	}
	bSieging = false;
	while (1)
	{
		bool bCat = false;	
		ol = qryDef.GetObjList();
		if (ol.count <= 0)
			break;
		if (!oTarget.IsEnemy(ol[0]))
			break;
		/// siege logic
		if (set.UnitsCount == 0)
			bToSiege = false; /// siege when there are many enemies
		else
		{	/// calculate enemies
			Query ProtectiveArea, EnemyUnits;
			ProtectiveArea = ObjsInSight(set.GetCentralBuilding, "Unit");
			EnemyUnits = Intersect(ProtectiveArea, EnemyObjs(AIPlayer, "Unit"));
			nEnemies = set.UnitsCount + EnemyUnits.count;
			if (ol.count <= nEnemies)
				bToSiege = true; /// siege when there are many enemies
		}
		if (bSieging) if (ol.count > 4 * nEnemies)
			{ bSieging = false;	bToSiege = false; } /// capture when our army is too larger
		if (!bSieging) if (bToSiege)
		{	/// start sieging
			nMaxCatapults = ol.count / 15;
			if (nMaxCatapults <= 0)
				nMaxCatapults = 1;
			ol.Siege(oTarget, nMaxCatapults, 0);
			bSieging = true;
		}
		bToSiege = bSieging;
		for (j = 0; j < ol.count; j += 1)
		{
			u = ol[j].AsUnit;
			if (!u.IsValid)
				continue;
			if (u.hero.IsValid)
				 continue;
			if (u.InHolder)	{
				bCat = true;
				if (bSieging)
					continue;
				u.SetCommand("advance", oTarget.pos);
			}
			if (u.command == "build_catapult")
				bCat = true;
			if (u.command == "engage")
				uEnemy = u.BestTargetInSquadSight.AsUnit;
			if (u.command != "idle" && u.command != "attack" && u.command != "move" && u.command != "advance")
				continue;
			if (uEnemy.IsAlive)	if (rand(3) == 0)
				{ u.SetCommand("advance", uEnemy.pos); continue; }
			if (!bSieging)
				if (u.DistTo(oTarget) < 500)
					if (u.command != "capture")
						u.SetCommand("capture", oTarget);
				else
					if (u.command != "advance")
						u.SetCommand("advance", oTarget.pos);
			else
			{
				pt = u.pos - oTarget.pos;
				n = pt.Len + 1;
				if (n < 900 || n > 1000) {
					pt = pt * (900 + rand(100)) / n;
					pt = pt + oTarget.pos;
					pt.IntoRect(rcMap);
					u.SetCommand("advance", pt);
				}
			}
		}
		if (bSieging && !bCat)
			bSieging = false;	
		Sleep(2000);
	}
	/// stop catapults
	for (j = 0; j < ol.count; j += 1)
	{
		u = ol[j].AsUnit;
		if (!u.IsValid) continue;
		if (u.hero.IsValid) continue;
		if (u.GetHolderSett.IsValid)	{
			Catapult cat;	cat = u.GetHolderSett.GetCentralBuilding.AsCatapult;
			if (cat.IsValid) cat.SetCommand("stop");
		}
	}

	return;
}	/// end Outpost
	
/// Stronhold
if (ol.count <= 0)
	return;
oTarget = set.BestGate(ol[0].pos);

if (set.IsStronghold&&oTarget.IsValid())
{

// pr("Find gather point");

	{

		ol = qryDef.GetObjList();

			return;
		for (j = 0; j < ol.count; j += 1)
		{
			u = ol[j].AsUnit;

				uEnemy = u.BestTargetInSquadSight.AsUnit;

			if (uEnemy.IsAlive)	if (rand(3) == 0)

					pt = pt * (900 + rand(100)) / n;
					pt = pt + oTarget.pos;
					pt.IntoRect(rcMap);

			}
		}

			bSieging = false;

	}

//void, str group_name, str set_name

//WARNING: this script does not support multiple wall layers or repairs

Settlement set;

set = GetSettlement(set_name);

if (set.IsValid) {
	Building main_target;
	ObjList ol_siegers;

	main_target = set.GetCentralBuilding();

	ol_siegers = Group(group_name).GetObjList();

	if (ol_siegers.count > 0)
		if (ol_siegers[0].IsEnemy(main_target)) {
			Unit u;
			Obj o;
			str cmd;
			rect rc;
			point pt, main_target_pos;
			int i, j;

			rc = GetMapRect();
			main_target_pos = main_target.pos;

			if (set.IsOutpost) {
				bool is_sieging, cataps_or_ranged;

				//step 1: wait for most heroes and detached units to gather near the outpost
				while (true) {
					ol_siegers = Group(group_name).GetObjList();
					if (ol_siegers.count <= 0)
						return;
					if (!ol_siegers[0].IsEnemy(main_target))
						return;
					j = 0;
					for (i = ol_siegers.count - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
						u = ol_siegers[i].AsUnit();
						if (u.IsValid)
							if (u.IsAlive)
								if (u.hero.IsDead) {
									cmd = u.command;
									if (u.DistTo(main_target) > 1600) {
										if (cmd == "move") {
											o = u.BestTargetInSquadSightMisZeroDamage();
											if (o.IsAlive)
												if (!o.IsSentry)
													u.SetCommand("advance", main_target_pos);
										}
										else if (cmd == "engage") {
											o = u.BestTargetInSquadSightMisZeroDamage();
											if (o.IsDead)
												u.SetCommand("move", main_target_pos);
											else if (o.IsSentry)
												u.SetCommand("move", main_target_pos);
										}
										else if (cmd != "advance")
											u.SetCommand("advance", main_target_pos);
									}
									else {
										if (cmd != "capture")
											if (cmd != "engage")
												if (cmd != "idle") {
													o = u.BestTargetInSquadSightMisZeroDamage();
													if (o.IsDead)
														is_sieging = true;
													else
														is_sieging = o.IsSentry;
													if (is_sieging)
														if (set.UnitsCount > 0)
															u.SetCommand("idle");
														else
															u.SetCommand("capture", main_target);
													else
														u.SetCommand("advance", o.pos);
												}
										j += 1;
										if (u.AsHero().IsValid)
											j += u.AsHero().army.count;
									}
								}
					}
					if (j >= ol_siegers.count * 2 / 3)
						break;
					Sleep(3000);
				}

				//step 2: siege (only if there are units inside and the attackers are not heavily outnumbering the defenders) and capture
				is_sieging = false;
				while (true) {
					ol_siegers = Group(group_name).GetObjList();
					if (ol_siegers.count <= 0)
						return;
					if (!ol_siegers[0].IsEnemy(main_target))
						break;//use break instead of return in order to clear catapults (step 3)

					i = set.UnitsCount;
					if (i > 0) {
						if (ol_siegers.count > 4 * (i + Intersect(VisibleObjsInSight(main_target, "Military"), FriendlyObjs(main_target.player, "Military")).count))
							is_sieging = false;
						else if (!is_sieging) {
							ol_siegers.Siege(main_target, MAX(1, ol_siegers.count / 20), 0);//max catapults
							is_sieging = true;
						}
					}
					else
						is_sieging = false;

					cataps_or_ranged = false;
					for (i = ol_siegers.count - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
						u = ol_siegers[i].AsUnit();
						if (u.IsValid)
							if (u.IsAlive)
								if (u.hero.IsDead) {
									if (u.InHolder)
										if (is_sieging)
											cataps_or_ranged = true;
										else {
											u.SetCommand("advance", main_target_pos);
											u.AddCommand(false, "capture", main_target);
										}
									else {
										cmd = u.command;
										if (cmd == "build_catapult")
											if (is_sieging)
												cataps_or_ranged = true;
											else {
												u.SetCommand("advance", main_target_pos);
												u.AddCommand(false, "capture", main_target);
											}
										else if (is_sieging)
											if (u.DistTo(main_target) > 1600) {//try to reach the outpost as soon as possible when far (new units added to the group)
												if (cmd == "idle")
													u.SetCommand("advance", main_target_pos);
												else if (cmd == "stand_position")
													u.SetCommand("advance", main_target_pos);
												else if (cmd == "engage") {
													o = u.BestTargetInSquadSightMisZeroDamage();//ignore sentries found on the way
													if (o.IsDead)
														u.SetCommand("move", main_target_pos);
													else if (o.IsSentry)
														u.SetCommand("move", main_target_pos);
													else if (rand(25) == 0)//very low chance to reduce the risk of a move-engage cycle and attract more enemies to the outpost
														u.SetCommand("move", main_target_pos);
												}
												else if (cmd == "move")
													if (rand(2) == 0) {
														o = u.BestTargetInSquadSightMisZeroDamage();
														if (o.IsAlive)
															if (!o.IsSentry)
																u.SetCommand("advance", main_target_pos);
													}
											}
											else {
												if (cmd != "capture")
													if (cmd != "attack")
														if (cmd != "idle")
															if (cmd != "stand_position")

																	continue;
												if (u.AsHero().IsValid) {
													o = u.BestTargetInSquadSightMisZeroDamage();
													if (o.IsDead) {//if there is not an enemy nearby, hero armies will attack/capture the target if many units are ranged
														ObjList h_army;
														int r;

														h_army = u.AsHero().army;
														for (j = h_army.count - 1; j >= 0; j -= 1) {
															o = h_army[j];
															if (o.IsAlive)
																if (o.IsRanged)
																	r += 1;
														}

														if (r >= 30) {
															if (u.IsRanged) {
																if (cmd != "attack")
																	u.SetCommand("attack", main_target);
															}
															else if (cmd != "capture")
																u.SetCommand("capture", main_target);

															//keep army commands after the hero otherwise the latter overwrites them
															for (j = h_army.count - 1; j >= 0; j -= 1) {
																o = h_army[j];
																if (o.IsAlive)

													o = u.BestTargetInSquadSightMisZeroDamage();

														if (cmd != "attack")
															u.SetCommand("attack", main_target);

									}
									else if (cmd == "capture") {//chance to abort the capture and attack an enemy nearby (ignore sentries and spammed barracks units)
										if (u.DistTo(main_target) <= 300) {
											if (rand(6) == 0) {
												o = u.BestTargetInSquadSightMisZeroDamage();
												if (o.IsAlive)
													if (!o.IsSentry) {
														if (o.AsUnit().IsValid)
															if (o.AsUnit().hero.IsDead)
																if (o.IsRanged) {//shorter ranges for archers because they do not need to move much to attack after being recruited
																	if (ObjsInRange(o, "BaseBarracks", 80).count > 0)
																		if (ObjsInRange(o, o.class, 100).count < 6)
																			if (Intersect(ObjsInSight(main_target, "Military"), FriendlyObjs(main_target.player, "Military")).count < 10)
																				continue;
																}
																else if (ObjsInRange(o, "BaseBarracks", 120).count > 0)
																	if (ObjsInRange(o, o.class, 150).count < 6)
																		if (Intersect(ObjsInSight(main_target, "Military"), FriendlyObjs(main_target.player, "Military")).count < 10)
																			continue;
														u.SetCommand("advance", o.pos);
													}
											}
										}
										else if (rand(2) == 0) {//good chance in order to reduce the risk of ignoring the enemy (for idle units and new ones added to the group)
											o = u.BestTargetInSquadSightMisZeroDamage();
											if (o.IsAlive)
												if (!o.IsSentry)
													u.SetCommand("advance", main_target_pos);
										}
									}
									else if (cmd == "engage") {//chance to abort the fight and either capture the target or move to it depending on the distance
										o = u.BestTargetInSquadSightMisZeroDamage();
										if (o.IsDead)
											if (u.DistTo(main_target) <= 400)
												u.SetCommand("capture", main_target);
											else
												u.SetCommand("move", main_target_pos);
										else if (o.IsSentry)
											if (u.DistTo(main_target) <= 400)
												u.SetCommand("capture", main_target);
											else
												u.SetCommand("move", main_target_pos);
										else if (u.DistTo(main_target) <= 400) {
											if (rand(2) == 0)//few spammed barracks units should not be considered much to avoid fighting forever
												if (o.AsUnit().IsValid)
													if (o.AsUnit().hero.IsDead)
														if (o.IsRanged) {//shorter ranges for archers because they do not need to move much to attack
															if (ObjsInRange(o, "BaseBarracks", 80).count > 0)
																if (ObjsInRange(o, o.class, 100).count < 6)
																	if (Intersect(VisibleObjsInSight(main_target, "Military"), FriendlyObjs(main_target.player, "Military")).count < 10) {
																		u.SetCommand("capture", main_target);
																		continue;
																	}
														}
														else if (ObjsInRange(o, "BaseBarracks", 120).count > 0)
															if (ObjsInRange(o, o.class, 150).count < 6)
																if (Intersect(VisibleObjsInSight(main_target, "Military"), FriendlyObjs(main_target.player, "Military")).count < 10) {
																	u.SetCommand("capture", main_target);
																	continue;
																}
											if (rand(14) == 0)
												u.SetCommand("capture", main_target);
										}
										else if (rand(25) == 0)//very low chance to reduce the risk of a move-engage cycle
											u.SetCommand("move", main_target_pos);
									}
									else if (cmd == "move")//when near, stop moving and start capturing
										if (u.DistTo(main_target) <= 400) {
											u.SetCommand("engage");
											u.AddCommand(false, "capture", main_target);
										}
										else if (rand(2) == 0) {
											o = u.BestTargetInSquadSightMisZeroDamage();
											if (o.IsAlive)
												if (!o.IsSentry)
													u.SetCommand("advance", main_target_pos);
										}
								}
					}
					Sleep(3000);
				}
			}
		}
}
```

```text
//void, Obj owner

ObjList ol, olToDie;
Unit u, this;
int i, nCount;

if( owner.AsUnit.InHolder )
{
	UserNotification("item cannot use in holder", "", owner.posRH, owner.player);
	return;
}

ItemUsed(1);
this = owner.AsUnit();

ol = Union(Union(ObjsInSight(this, "BaseMage"),ObjsInSight(this, "Melee")),ObjsInSight(this, "Ranged")).GetObjList();
nCount=0;

if (ol.count > 0)
	for (i=0; i<30 && nCount<3; i+=1) { //make 30 attempts to kill 
		u = ol[rand(ol.count)];
		if (u.IsDead()) continue;
		if (.IsEnemy(u) && !u.AsHero().IsValid() && !olToDie.Contains(u)) {
			nCount+=1;
			olToDie.Add(u);
		}
	}

//if after 30 random attempts 3 enemies are not kill, damage them in order

	if (.IsEnemy(u) && !u.AsHero().IsValid() && !olToDie.Contains(u)) {
		nCount+=1;
		olToDie.Add(u);
	}
}

for (i=0; i<olToDie.count && i<3; i+=1) { //just in case check if less than 3
	CreateFeedback("Lightning2", olToDie[i].AsUnit());
}
Sleep(5000);
for (i=0; i<olToDie.count && i<3; i+=1) { //just in case check if less than 3
	olToDie[i].Damage(100000);
}

return;
```

```text
		charges -= 20;
```

```text
//void, Obj This

bool bRespawn;
str items, item; 
Building this;
int count, idx, minlevel, timetorest;
Item item_obj;
Hero hero;

this = This.AsBuilding;
minlevel = .minlevel;
EnvWriteInt(this, "minlevel", minlevel);
bRespawn = true;
timetorest = 0;

Sleep(rand(1000) + 500);

while(1)
{
	if(bRespawn)
	{
		// first count 'em
		count = 0;
		items = .itemtypes;
		while(items != "")
		{
			item = ParseStr(items, items);
			count += 1;
		}
		idx = rand(count);

		items = .itemtypes;
		while(idx > 0)
		{
			item = ParseStr(items, items);
			idx -= 1;
		}
		.AddItem(item);
		item_obj = .FindItem(item);
		bRespawn = false;
	}
	if(.settlement.UnitsCount > 0)
	{
		hero = .settlement.Units[0].AsHero();
		if (hero.IsAlive)
		{
			hero.Deselect();
			Sleep(10000);
			if (hero.IsAlive)
			if (hero.InHolder)
			{
				bool bCanGetItem = false;
				//if (10 * hero.health >= 9 * hero.maxhealth)
				if (hero.level >= minlevel)
				if (hero.item_count < hero.max_items)
					bCanGetItem = true;
				if (hero.health > hero.maxhealth * 50 / 100)
					hero.Damage(hero.health - hero.maxhealth * 50 / 100);
				if(hero.CmdCount == 1)
					hero.AddCommand(true, "move", .GetExitPoint(hero, .pos)+Point(10, 50));
				hero.KillCommand();
				if (timetorest == 0 && bCanGetItem)
				{
					minlevel += .levelperitem;
					EnvWriteInt(this, "minlevel", minlevel);
					Sleep(250);
					.GiveItem(item_obj, hero);
					timetorest = 600;
				} else
				{
					continue;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if(timetorest == 1 && !bRespawn)
	{
		bRespawn = true;
	}		
	if(timetorest > 0)
		timetorest -= 1;

	Sleep(1000);
}
```

```text
// void, Obj This

Building this;
Query qSight, qEnemies, qFriends;

point p;
rect rc;
int exp_gain, old_exp_gain;

//constants
int nArmy,			//how much units to spawn at max
	nActiveArmy,	//how much units to keep outside if an enemy comes
	nUnitSpawnRate;	//how often a new unit appears if nobody is around

int nTimeFromLastSpawn;
int nGroupSpawn;
int old_player;

this = This.AsBuilding();
nArmy = GetConst("TTentInitialArmy");// max armmy of TeutonArchers and TeutonRiders
nActiveArmy = GetConst("TTentActiveArmy");
nUnitSpawnRate= GetConst("TTentUnitSpawnRate");

rc = GetMapRect();

.settlement.SetLoyalty(100); //will not be able to capture it the normal way

Sleep(rand(1000) + 500);

nGroupSpawn = 2;
nTimeFromLastSpawn = nUnitSpawnRate * nArmy ; // this will cause respawn of half the army in the beggining

qSight = VisibleObjsInSight(this, "Unit");
qEnemies = Intersect(qSight, Union(EnemyObjs(.player, "Military"),EnemyObjs(.player, "BaseMage")));
qFriends = Intersect(qSight, ClassPlayerObjs("Military", .player));
old_player = .player;

//---------------[ main loop ]------------------------------------

old_exp_gain = 0;
while (1) {
	bool bCanSpawn;
	bool bHasFood;
	bool bIsIndependent;
	int foodcost;

	exp_gain = GetTime() / 120000 - 5;
	if (exp_gain < 0)
		exp_gain = 0;
	
	// respawn
	bCanSpawn = true;
	bIsIndependent = .settlement.IsIndependent();
	foodcost = 400;
	
	olAll1.ClearDead();
	olAll2.ClearDead();
    
    if (bIsIndependent){
        while (nTimeFromLastSpawn > nUnitSpawnRate * nGroupSpawn && bCanSpawn) 
        {
            int nSpawn;
            nSpawn = 0;
            nTimeFromLastSpawn -= nUnitSpawnRate * nGroupSpawn;
            
            while (nSpawn<nGroupSpawn && bCanSpawn)
            {
                if (olAll1.count>=nArmy && olAll2.count>=nArmy)
                {
                    bCanSpawn = false;
                    break;
                }
                if (olAll1.count<nArmy)
                {
                    Unit u1;
                    u1 = Place("TTeutonArcher", .pos, .player);
                    u1.SetFood(u1.maxfood);
                    u1.SetFeeding(false);
                    .settlement.ForceAddUnit(u1);
                    u1.SetExperience(old_exp_gain);
                    olAll1.Add(u1);
                    nSpawn+=1;
                }
                if (olAll2.count<nArmy )
                {
                    Unit u2;
                    u2 = Place("TTeutonRider", .pos, .player);
                    u2.SetFood(u2.maxfood);
                    u2.SetFeeding(false);
                    .settlement.ForceAddUnit(u2);
                    u2.SetExperience(old_exp_gain);
                    olAll2.Add(u2);
                    nSpawn+=1;
                }
            }
        }
        
    olTeutonsOut.ClearDead();
	// clear the teutons that were commanded from our list
	for (i = olTeutonsOut.count - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1)
		if (olTeutonsOut[i].AsUnit().GetCommanded())
			olTeutonsOut.Remove(olTeutonsOut[i]);
	//increase experience
	if ((exp_gain != 0) && (exp_gain > old_exp_gain)) {
		Unit u;
		olOurTeutons = olTeutonsOut;
		olOurTeutons.AddList(.settlement.Units());
		for (i = olOurTeutons.count() - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
			u = olOurTeutons[i];
			u.SetExperience(u.experience + exp_gain - old_exp_gain);
		}
		old_exp_gain = exp_gain;
	}
	if (qEnemies.IsEmpty()) { // no threat around
		// command all that are out to come back in
		for (i = 0; i < olTeutonsOut.count; i += 1)
			olTeutonsOut[i].SetCommand("enter_tent", this); //force add even though the tent does not allow units inside
		olTeutonsOut.Clear();
	} else {
		// do not allow our teutons to wander too far
		for (i = 0; i < olTeutonsOut.count; i += 1) {
			Unit u;
			u = olTeutonsOut[i].AsUnit();
			if (.DistTo(u) > .sight) { // move to closer random position
				point pos;
				pos = u.pos - .pos;
				pos.SetLen(.sight / 2);
				p = pos + .pos; p.IntoRect(rc);	u.SetCommand("move", p);
				pos.Rot(90);	p = pos + .pos; p.IntoRect(rc);	u.AddCommand(false, "patrol", p);
				pos.Rot(90);	p = pos + .pos; p.IntoRect(rc);	u.AddCommand(false, "patrol", p);
				pos.Rot(90);	p = pos + .pos; p.IntoRect(rc);	u.AddCommand(false, "patrol", p);
				pos.Rot(90);	p = pos + .pos; p.IntoRect(rc);	u.AddCommand(false, "patrol", p);
			}
		}
		// get out more teutons if needed
		while (olTeutonsOut.count < nActiveArmy && .settlement.UnitsCount() > 0) {

			u = .settlement.Units()[0];
			olTeutonsOut.Add(u);
			pos.Set(0, .sight / 2);
			pos.Rot(rand(360));	p = pos + .pos; p.IntoRect(rc);	u.SetCommand("advance", p);
			pos.Rot(90);		p = pos + .pos; p.IntoRect(rc);	u.AddCommand(false, "patrol", p);
			pos.Rot(90);		p = pos + .pos; p.IntoRect(rc);	u.AddCommand(false, "patrol", p);
			pos.Rot(90);		p = pos + .pos; p.IntoRect(rc);	u.AddCommand(false, "patrol", p);

			}
			if (k >= 0) break;

			list1 = qEnemies.GetObjList();

					break;
			}
			if (k < 0) break;

}

//void, Obj This

Building this;
Settlement set;
ObjList all_defenders, defenders_1, defenders_2, defenders_outside, enemies;
Unit u;
point pt_pos, pt_1, pt_2;
rect rc;
str unit_class_1, unit_class_2;
int i, j, plr, rad, rng, rng_half, initial_army, active_army, spawn_rate, last_spawn_time, delay, exp_gain, old_exp_gain;
bool first_time_independent;

Sleep(750 + rand(751));

this = This.AsBuilding();

set = .settlement;

set.SetLoyalty(100);//impossible to capture until the garrison is defeated

rc = GetMapRect();

plr = .player;
rad = .radius + 150;
rng = .range;
rng_half = rng / 2;
pt_pos = .pos;

initial_army = GetConst("TentInitialArmy");
active_army = GetConst("TentActiveArmy");
spawn_rate = GetConst("TentUnitSpawnRate");

last_spawn_time = spawn_rate * initial_army / 2;//spawn half of the army at the beginning

first_time_independent = set.IsIndependent;

if (.class == "CTent") {
	unit_class_1 = "CLibyanFootman";
	unit_class_2 = "CHorseman";
}
else {
	unit_class_1 = "TTeutonRider";
	unit_class_2 = "TTeutonArcher";
}

while (true) {
	if (plr != .player) {//this lets the old units recapture the tent (it should happen only with adventure sequences)
		defenders_1.Clear();
		defenders_2.Clear();
		defenders_outside.Clear();
		if (plr != 15)//independent "non-rescue" units must not starve (16 = rescue)
			for (i = all_defenders.count - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
				u = all_defenders[i].AsUnit();
				if (u.IsAlive)
					u.SetFeeding(true);
			}
		all_defenders.Clear();
		plr = .player;
	}

	pt_1.Set(0, rad);
	pt_1.Rot(rand(360));
	set.Units.ObjEnemy(plr).SetCommand("advance", pt_1 + pt_pos);//send away enemy units inside

	if (set.IsIndependent) {//spawn neutral units
		defenders_1.ClearDead();
		defenders_2.ClearDead();
		while (last_spawn_time > spawn_rate) {
			last_spawn_time -= spawn_rate;
			if (defenders_1.count >= initial_army)
				if (defenders_2.count >= initial_army)
					break;
			if (defenders_1.count < initial_army) {
				u = Place(unit_class_1, pt_pos, plr).AsUnit();
				set.ForceAddUnit(u);
				u.SetFeeding(false);
				u.SetExperience(old_exp_gain);
				u.SetNoAIFlag(true);
				defenders_1.Add(u);
				all_defenders.Add(u);
			}
			if (defenders_2.count < initial_army) {
				u = Place(unit_class_2, pt_pos, plr).AsUnit();
				set.ForceAddUnit(u);
				u.SetFeeding(false);
				u.SetExperience(old_exp_gain);
				u.SetNoAIFlag(true);
				defenders_2.Add(u);
				all_defenders.Add(u);
			}
		}
		last_spawn_time += 1000;
	}
	else if (delay >= spawn_rate) {//spawn produced units
		str class_prod;
		class_prod = EnvReadString(set, "ENV_TProd");
		if (class_prod == "CLibyanFootman") {
			if (set.food >= 200) {
				set.SetFood(set.food - 200);
				u = Place(class_prod, pt_pos, plr).AsUnit();
				set.ForceAddUnit(u);
				u.SetFeeding(false);
				u.SetExperience(old_exp_gain);
				all_defenders.Add(u);
			}
		}
		else if (class_prod != "")
			if (set.food >= 400) {
				set.SetFood(set.food - 400);
				u = Place(class_prod, pt_pos, plr).AsUnit();
				set.ForceAddUnit(u);
				u.SetFeeding(false);
				u.SetExperience(old_exp_gain);
				all_defenders.Add(u);
			}
		delay = 0;
	}
	else
		delay += 1000;

	for (i = all_defenders.count - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {//set feeding of commanded units
		u = all_defenders[i].AsUnit();
		if (u.IsDead)
			all_defenders.Remove(u);
		else if (u.GetCommanded()) {
			u.SetFeeding(true);
			all_defenders.Remove(u);
		}
	}

	exp_gain = GetTime() / 60000 - 4;//start gaining experience after 5 minutes
	if (exp_gain > old_exp_gain) {
		for (i = all_defenders.count - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
			u = all_defenders[i].AsUnit();
			if (u.IsDead)
				all_defenders.Remove(u);
			else
				u.SetExperience(u.experience + exp_gain - old_exp_gain);
		}
		old_exp_gain = exp_gain;
	}

	enemies = Intersect(
		VisibleObjsInSight(this, "Military,BaseMage"),
		Subtract(
			Union(EnemyObjs(plr, "Military"), EnemyObjs(plr, "BaseMage")),
			EnemyObjs(plr, "Sentry")
		)
	).GetObjList();

	if (enemies.count <= 0) {//no threat around, command all units that are out to come back in
		defenders_outside.SetCommand("guard_enter", this);
		defenders_outside.Clear();
	}
	else {
		for (i = defenders_outside.count - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {//do not allow units to wander too far
			u = defenders_outside[i].AsUnit();
			if (u.IsDead)
				defenders_outside.Remove(u);
			else if (.DistTo(u) > rng) {
				pt_1 = u.pos - pt_pos;
				pt_1.SetLen(rng_half);
				pt_2 = pt_1 + pt_pos;
				pt_2.IntoRect(rc);
				u.SetCommand("move", pt_2);
				for (j = 0; j < 4; j += 1) {
					pt_1.Rot(90);
					pt_2 = pt_1 + pt_pos;
					pt_2.IntoRect(rc);
					u.AddCommand(false, "guard_patrol", pt_2);
				}
			}
		}

		for (i = all_defenders.count - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {//get out more units if needed
			u = all_defenders[i].AsUnit();
			if (u.IsDead)
				all_defenders.Remove(u);
			else if (defenders_outside.count < active_army)
				if (u.InHolder) {
					defenders_outside.Add(u);
					pt_1.Set(0, rng_half);
					pt_1.Rot(rand(360));
					pt_2 = pt_1 + pt_pos;
					pt_2.IntoRect(rc);
					u.SetCommand("guard_advance", pt_2);
					for (j = 0; j < 4; j += 1) {
						pt_1.Rot(90);
						pt_2 = pt_1 + pt_pos;
						pt_2.IntoRect(rc);
						u.AddCommand(false, "guard_patrol", pt_2);
					}
				}
		}

		if (all_defenders.count <= 0) {//handle the capturing (the new player will be chosen randomly among those with most warriors nearby)
			enemies = enemies.ObjClass("Military");
			enemies.ClearDead();
			i = enemies.count;
			if (i > 0)
				if (Intersect(VisibleObjsInSight(this, "Unit"), FriendlyObjs(plr, "Military")).IsEmpty) {//exclude hidden allies (just like with capturable buildings)
					IntArray player_warriors, players;
					int max, p;
					for (j = 0; j < i; j += 1)
						player_warriors[enemies[j].player] += 1;//count warriors per player
					for (i = 1; i <= 16; i += 1) {
						j = player_warriors[i];
						if (j > 0)
							if (j > max) {//new max found, reset the players to choose from
								max = j;
								players.resize(0);
								players[0] = i;
								p = 1;
							}
							else if (j == max) {//add one more player to choose from
								players[p] = i;
								p += 1;
							}
					}
					if (p > 0)
						.SetPlayer(players[rand(p)]);
				}
		}
	}

	if (first_time_independent)//spawn some units for the new player (only once)
		if (!set.IsIndependent) {//avoid giving units/resources to possible neutral units coming from other outposts
			j = GetConst("TentCapturedArmy");
			plr = .player;
			for (i = 0; i < j; i += 1) {
				u = Place(unit_class_1, pt_pos, plr).AsUnit();
				set.ForceAddUnit(u);
				u.SetExperience(old_exp_gain);
				u.SetFeeding(false);
				all_defenders.Add(u);
				u = Place(unit_class_2, pt_pos, plr).AsUnit();
				set.ForceAddUnit(u);
				u.SetExperience(old_exp_gain);
				u.SetFeeding(false);
				all_defenders.Add(u);
			}
			first_time_independent = false;
		}

	Sleep(1000);
```
